__broaden__.αὐτῶν: αὐτός — self; gen. pl. as the plain personal pronoun after a preposition: ’them’ (ἐπ’ αὐτῶν ’on them’) · also gen. pl. dependent on a noun, ’of them’ (ἄνυσις … αὐτῶν ’accomplishment of them’) · also intensive, gen. pl. agreeing with a noun: ’of the men themselves’ (ποδῶν αὐτῶν τε καὶ ἵππων ’of the very men’s feet and of the horses’) · also gen. pl. standing alone for the men, as against their horses: ’of the men themselves’ (αὐτῶν ἠδ’ ἵππων ’of the men and of the horses’) · also intensive, gen. pl. with a pronoun: τῶν … αὐτῶν ’of those very men’ · also gen. pl. plain pronoun governed by ἀντίον: ’them’ (ἀντίον … αὐτῶν ’face to face with them’) · also gen. pl. plain pronoun governed by σχεδόν: ’them’ (σχεδὸν … αὐτῶν ’close to them’) · also intensive, gen. pl. with καί, dependent on a noun: ’their own’ (καὶ αὐτῶν θυμός ’their own heart, too’)

__broaden__.οἱ: οἱ — encl. dat. sg. pron. ’to/for him, her’ · also ὁ, ἡ, τό, masc. nom. pl. ’they’ · also masc. nom. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (οἱ ἄριστοι ’the best men’)
__broaden__.οἷσιν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις), agreeing with ἅρμασιν: ’its own’ · also masc. dat. pl., used as a noun: ’his own (men)’ · also relative ὅς, masc. dat. pl.: ’on whom’ (οἷσιν ἐπὶ … θῆκε ’on whom … set’)
__broaden__.πάρος: πάρος — before, formerly; adv.: ’once before’, with a finite verb · also with a participle: ’already, from before’ (πάρος μεμαυῖαν ’already eager’) · also correlative with πρίν, ’before (that)’ (πάρος … πρίν ’not … until’) · also + inf.: ’before’ (πάρος … γενέσθαι ’before … came to be’)
__broaden__.τῇ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; fem. dat. sg. · with an ordinal, ’on the (day)’: τῇ δεκάτῃ ’on the tenth’ · also adverbial, ’by that way, there’ · also fem. dat. sg. as relative adverb: ’by which way’ (τῇ … ἔμελλε διεξίμεναι ’by which he was about to go out’)
__broaden__.ἄλκιμον: ἄλκιμος — strong in defence, staunch (from ἀλκή); neut. acc. sg. · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with υἱόν: ’valiant’
__broaden__.ἄλλη: ἄλλος — other, another; fem. nom. sg., distributive: ἄλλη δ’ ἄλλων γλῶσσα ’each tongue differing from the others’ · also fem. nom. sg., agreeing with θαλπωρή: ’(no) other (comfort)’
__broaden__.ἄλλοισι: ἄλλος — other; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις) · also neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι, agreeing with κτεάτεσσιν: ’the other (possessions)’
__broaden__.ἠέ: ἠέ — than (after a comparative); epic form of ἤ · also ἠέ = ἦε, ’or’, introducing a second question
__broaden__.ἥ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); fem. nom. sg., accented ἥ before γε: ’she’ · also fem. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ἥ τε κόμη ’and the hair’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, fem. nom. sg., ’which’ (ἥ τε … πέληται ’which shall be’) · also fem. nom. sg. pronoun, accented ἥ before the enclitic οἱ: ’she’
__broaden__.ἰῷ: ἰός — arrow; masc. dat. sg., instrumental: ’with an arrow’ (not ἰός ’poison’) · also ἰῷ = Attic μιᾷ, ’one’, dat. sg. agreeing with ἤματι (ἰῷ … ἤματι ’on a single day’)
__broaden__.ἴδωμαι: ὁράω (aor. stem ἰδ-) — see; aor. subj. 1 sg. mid., with future force: ’shall I see’ · also aor. subj. 1 sg. mid. in a purpose clause after ὄφρα: ’so that I may see’
__broaden__.ἀνώγει: ἄνωγα (perf. with pres. force) — command, bid, order; impf. 3 sg., + inf.: ’was bidding’ · also pres. 3 sg., paired with ἐποτρύνει: ’bids’
__broaden__.ἂν: ἀνά — up, aboard; prep./preverb, with apocope ἂν before δ’; in tmesis (ἂν … βήσομεν ’put aboard’) · also modal particle ἄν (= κεν) written ἂν: with the opt., potential: ’would’; with the subj. after εὖτ’: ’whenever’ · also with ὡς + subj.: ’in the way that’ (ὡς ἂν ἐγὼ εἴπω ’as I may say’) · also modal particle with the subj. after ὅτ’: ’whenever’ (ὅτ’ ἂν … γένωνται ’whenever they come to be’) · also modal particle with a fut. or short-vowel subj.: ’could’ (οὐκ ἂν … μυθήσομαι ’I could not tell’) · also εἴ περ ἂν + opt., ’even if … should’ · also εἴ περ ἂν + subj., ’even if … ever’ (εἴ περ ἂν αὐτὸν σεύωνται ’even if they set upon him’) · also εἰ … ἂν + subj., ’if ever, should’ (εἰ δ’ ἂν … ἐθέλωσιν ’but if they should be unwilling’) · also with an indic. past tense, contrary to fact: ’would have’ (ἂν … ἦεν ’would have been’) · also modal particle ἄν with the subj. after ὄφρα: ’until, while’ (ὄφρ’ ἂν … βείω ’until I go’) · also modal particle ἄν after ἐπεί + subj.: ’once’ (ἐπεὶ ἂν … ἐπίσπῃς ’once you have met’)
__broaden__.ὥς: ὡς — as; so that; accented ὥς before an enclitic, as in ὥς κε ’so that’ (+ subj.) · also ὥς = ὣς, ’so, thus’, accented before an enclitic (ὥς νύ περ ὧδε ’just so, as now’) · also ὥς κε + subj. in an indirect question: ’how’ (πειρᾶν ὥς κε … ’to try how …’) · also ὡς = ὅτι, ’that’, after a verb of knowing (οἶδα … ὥς ’I know that’) · also ὥς τε, accented before the enclitic τε: ’like, as’ (ὥς τ’ ὄϊες ’like sheep’) · also ὥς κέ + opt., in a wish: ’so (may) …’ · also ὥς before the enclitic με, introducing a wish with ὄφελ’: ’would that’ (ὥς μ’ ὄφελ’ … ’would that … had …’)
__broaden__.τοὔνεκά: τοὔνεκα (τοῦ + ἕνεκα, crasis) — therefore, for that reason; adv., accented before the enclitic οἱ · also accented before the enclitic μιν (τοὔνεκά μιν κάλεον ’for that reason they called him’) · also accented before the enclitic τοι: ’for that reason (I tell you)’
__broaden__.κράτος: κράτος — strength, power, might; neut. acc. sg. (object of τίθει) · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’power, might’ (τοῦ κράτος ἐστὶ μέγιστον) · also neut. acc. sg., subject of an infinitive in indirect statement: ’that the strength is great’ (μέγα … κράτος εἶναι ’that the strength is great’)
__broaden__.παῖδ: παῖς — child, daughter, son; fem. acc. sg., elided (παῖδ’ = παῖδα): ’child, daughter’ (παῖς is common gender) · also masc. acc. sg., elided: ’boy, son’ (παῖδ’ ὀρφανικόν ’the boy an orphan’)
__broaden__.παῖδά: παῖς — child, daughter; fem. acc. sg., accented before enclitic τε: ’daughter’ · also masc. acc. sg., accented before enclitic τε: ’boy, son’ (παῖδά τε νηπίαχον ’and the infant boy’)
